name: PumpSwap and pump.fun bonding curve

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: Both programs share one 3-of-4 Squads v4 upgrade multisig with no delay, and their config admin is a different multisig with the same 3-of-4 threshold, so the admin path does not lower the score.
narrative.tag: confirmed by the second path, not lowered
narrative.detail: The AMM and the bonding curve share one upgrade vault (3-of-4, no time lock). GlobalConfig.admin (PumpSwap) and Global.authority (bonding curve) both resolve to a different Squads v4 vault, also 3-of-4. The on-chain IDL shows admin as the first field, and a live transaction from that multisig updated both fields together, so it is not a coincidental match. Scouting noted frequent upgrades (2026-09-12 and 2026-09-15) with no delay. It listed over $250M TVL for PumpSwap, while pump.fun itself lists none.

cheapest_fix.what: a stronger admin setup (admin power spread beyond one key, or checked by others)

main_gap.requirement: A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
main_gap.reason: Changes can apply with no waiting time

independent_read.path: account owned by program pAMMBay6… -> program -> ProgramData 6naEzK… -> upgrade authority (a program-derived address, off the curve: a Squads vault or a protocol PDA, no key can sign for it directly) -> Squads v4 vault 0 of multisig 2yMoQqQrtbhq3nQ3wFoQQawWS65qcqUXcwHEYha4rshW
independent_read.posture: admin: Squads 3-of-4 of 4 plain keys; delay: none
